Package com.kerosene.kfe.paymentexecution.domain.model

Record Class SettlementBalanceSnapshot

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.kerosene.kfe.paymentexecution.domain.model.SettlementBalanceSnapshot
Record Components:
role - ledger account category
availableSats - currently available customer/system balance
pendingSats - unsettled incoming or outgoing balance
lockedSats - balance reserved by an in-flight operation
autoHoldSats - balance held automatically by ledger policy
observedSats - total observed balance used as a solvency asset input
public record SettlementBalanceSnapshot(SettlementWalletRole role, long availableSats, long pendingSats, long lockedSats, long autoHoldSats, long observedSats) extends Record
Ledger-cached balance buckets, not proof of live spendable reserve assets.
